existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `MedicationStatement` has high-impact local breaks. The top concerns are status/adherence semantics, dosage redesign, and removed/merged workflow/reason/context elements. The main uncertainty is the lack of official cross-version mapping guidance.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration requires explicit transforms for status/adherence, medication CodeableReference, reason CodeableReference, dosage DosageDetails, and removed workflow/context links. R6-to-R4 conversion is lossy for nuanced adherence, effectiveTiming, multiple categories/sources, author, and DosageDetails.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural changes because they come directly from local StructureDefinitions and CodeSystems. Confidence is medium for clinical mapping recommendations because official diffs, narrative rationale, terminology expansions, and cross-version ConceptMaps were not available.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
MedicationStatement keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 8 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 5 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 3, which creates meaningful stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 97/100, producing migration shape `major-model-remodel`, major migration `Yes`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: basedOn was removed
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: any R4 instance carrying `basedOn` is invalid as base R6; runtime workflows that follow order/plan fulfillment links need a redesign.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: MedicationStatement.status changed from medication-use status to recording status
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: common R4 status codes such as active, stopped, or not-taken are outside the R6 required value set; runtime/API/codegen logic that treated status as medication-use state must also change.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: dosage changed from repeating Dosage array to singular DosageDetails object
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `dosage` arrays are not the R6 object shape and multiple repetitions exceed R6 max=1; runtime/API/codegen and R6-to-R4 loss are also present because DosageDetails is a different dosage model.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: statusReason was removed and partially replaced by adherence.reason

topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
